title: Entry
description: The only unit of data in the Lamdis Protocol. Immutable, signed, hash-chained per (thread, author, lane). SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

v.description: Protocol envelope version. Fixed at 0 until spec v0.1 freezes.

id.description: ULID, assigned by the author at creation. Unique per entry; sortable tiebreaker only — ordering authority is (lamport, author).

thread.description: Thread id: the entry id of the thread's genesis entry (kind core.thread).

kind.description: Reverse-DNS namespaced entry kind. core.* is reserved for the spec. Nodes MUST replicate, store, and serve unknown kinds opaquely (must-replicate, may-ignore).

lane.description: Replication/permission class. control: membership, grants, delegations — replicated to every member at every scope. summary: tier>=1 summaries and thread cards. content: everything else.

author.description: Principal id of the signer: 'ed25519:' + base32-crockford(pubkey). A person key or a delegated agent key.

on_behalf_of.description: Person principal id when the author is a delegated agent key. Provenance MUST bottom out at a person.

seq.description: Per-(thread, author, lane) sequence number, starting at 1, no gaps. Basis of version-vector sync.

lamport.description: Lamport clock: greater than every lamport the author had observed in this thread when authoring. Total order = (lamport, author, id).

prev.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the previous entry by the same (thread, author, lane) chain, or 64 zeros for the first entry in a chain.

ts.description: Author-asserted RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Display only — never an ordering authority.

refs.description: Typed references to other entries. All values are entry ids unless noted.

derived_from.description: Provenance: entries this one was computed/summarized from.

supersedes.description: This entry replaces the referenced one (edits, living digests). Readers resolve to the latest non-superseded entry.

covers.description: For summaries: the contiguous range of content this summary covers, as entry ids.

body.description: Kind-defined JSON body. Kinds SHOULD put human/agent-readable prose in body.text — nodes index body.text for FTS and vector search when present.

sig.description: Lowercase hex Ed25519 signature by author over the canonical JSON of the entry with sig omitted (see spec/protocol.md#canonical-encoding).
